text: Elementary reductions are still 'asserted', not checked, and one is WRONG. code/out/verify_elementary_reductions.md/.py (just written, exact Fraction arithmetic, k up to 4999) confirms research/approaches/oracle-findings.md: the identity x=n,y=(n+1)/2,z=n(n+1)/2 for n=4k+3 solves 3/n NOT 4/n (residual is exactly 1/n). Do not cite it as covering n=3mod4 anywhere. The corrected identity n=4k+3,x=(n+1)/4,y=n(n+1)/4+1,z=y(y-1) does work and is now a checked claim (n-3mod4-covering-corrected). Also promote n-even-trivial (4/2m=1/m+1/2m+1/2m) to checked -- verified. Priority: run prime-reduction (composite n reduces to its smallest prime factor) through code, not just cited from Elsholtz-Tao, so it becomes checked too. These three plus prime-reduction are the whole reduction to 'odd prime p, p=1 mod 24' -- get them off 'asserted' before spending more budget on new identity search for the six square classes mod 840.
